decisions.reason: As a low-cost extension of the firm's existing training and service capabilities, this programme still has option value because it supports equipment sales and customer retention even without strong standalone evidence.
This accessory was only briefly visible and, after two years without continued market prominence, the likely limited demand no longer justifies keeping a niche option open.
Because it is distant from the firm's core offer and showed only minimal market presence, the uncertainty has largely resolved negatively and resources are better redeployed to closer opportunities.
Although close to the core business, a CNC machine is costly to market and support, and the lack of continued visibility suggests insufficient traction to justify further commitment.
This add-on fits the existing portfolio, but the short-lived standalone presence indicates that its commercial value was not strong enough to warrant continued dedicated support.
